process SPATIALCONTINUUMTRANSLATIONAL_GIST {
    tag "${meta.id}"
    label 'process_single'

    conda "${moduleDir}/environment.yml"
    container "${workflow.containerEngine in ['singularity', 'apptainer'] && !task.ext.singularity_pull_docker_container
        ? 'https://community-cr-prod.seqera.io/docker/registry/v2/blobs/sha256/a5/a50a8bbb2134cf3a6b6aa7214ba42989fda33ed2804a1bf0bcf2d24dd5f62cce/data'
        : 'community.wave.seqera.io/library/spatial-continuum-translational:0.1.53--ee1f749133648d82'}"

    input:
    tuple val(meta), path(input)

    output:
    tuple val(meta), path("${prefix}_gist.json"), emit: json, optional: true
    tuple val(meta), path("${prefix}_gist.tsv") , emit: tsv,  optional: true
    tuple val("${task.process}"), val('spatial-continuum-translational'), eval("python3 -c \"import importlib.metadata; print(importlib.metadata.version('spatial-continuum-translational'))\""), topic: versions, emit: versions_spatialcontinuumtranslational

    when:
    task.ext.when == null || task.ext.when

    script:
    def args = task.ext.args ?: ''
    prefix = task.ext.prefix ?: "${meta.id}"
    def format_match = (args =~ /(?:--format|-f)[=\s]+['"]?([a-zA-Z0-9]+)['"]?/)
    def format = format_match ? format_match[0][1].toLowerCase() : 'json'
    """
    spatial-continuum-gist \\
        --input "${input}" \\
        --output "${prefix}_gist.${format}" \\
        ${args}
    """

    stub:
    def args = task.ext.args ?: ''
    prefix = task.ext.prefix ?: "${meta.id}"
    def format_match = (args =~ /(?:--format|-f)[=\s]+['"]?([a-zA-Z0-9]+)['"]?/)
    def format = format_match ? format_match[0][1].toLowerCase() : 'json'
    """
    touch "${prefix}_gist.${format}"
    """
}

name: "nf-core/spatialcontinuumtranslational/gist"
description: "Calculate uncalibrated research-only GIST phenotype risk scores from\
  \ cohort data (TSV, CSV, JSON)."
keywords:
- "oncology"
- "gist"
- "spatial"
- "risk stratification"
- "phenotype"
tools:
- spatial-continuum-translational:
    description: "Deterministic GIST phenotype research profile CLI supporting validated\
      \ TSV, CSV, and JSON cohort inputs."
    homepage: "https://github.com/Lukecele/spatial-continuum-translational"
    documentation: "https://github.com/Lukecele/spatial-continuum-translational#readme"
    tool_dev_url: "https://github.com/Lukecele/spatial-continuum-translational"
    doi: "10.21203/rs.3.rs-11633521/v1"
    licence:
    - "MIT"
    identifier: "biotools:spatial-continuum-translational"
input:
- - meta:
      type: "map"
      description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1'\
        \ ]`\n"
  - input:
      type: "file"
      description: "Input file containing GIST clinical/histological features (TSV,\
        \ CSV, or JSON)"
      pattern: "*.{tsv,csv,json}"
      ontologies:
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3475"
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3752"
      - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3464"
output:
  json:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1'\
          \ ]`\n"
    - ${prefix}_gist.json:
        type: "file"
        description: "(Optional) GIST phenotype research profile score in JSON format"
        pattern: "${prefix}_gist.json"
        ontologies:
        - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3464"
  tsv:
  - - meta:
        type: "map"
        description: "Groovy Map containing sample information\ne.g. `[ id:'sample1'\
          \ ]`\n"
    - ${prefix}_gist.tsv:
        type: "file"
        description: "(Optional) GIST phenotype research profile score in TSV format"
        pattern: "${prefix}_gist.tsv"
        ontologies:
        - edam: "http://edamontology.org/format_3475"
  versions_spatialcontinuumtranslational:
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the process"
    - spatial-continuum-translational:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the tool"
    - python3 -c "import importlib.metadata; print(importlib.metadata.version('spatial-continuum-translational'))":
        type: "eval"
        description: "The expression to obtain the version of the tool"
topics:
  versions:
  - - ${task.process}:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the process"
    - spatial-continuum-translational:
        type: "string"
        description: "The name of the tool"
    - python3 -c "import importlib.metadata; print(importlib.metadata.version('spatial-continuum-translational'))":
        type: "eval"
